caption: The drawing depicts a tall, vertical wooden object resembling a barometer or similar scientific instrument. The wood is rendered in a dark brown color with lighter highlights to suggest texture and form. The structure consists of a rectangular base supporting a long, narrow central column, with decorative paneling at the base and near the middle of the column. On the upper portion, a rectangular glass-covered compartment encases a vertical panel with numerical markings, scales, and a metallic indicator or pointer, likely for measuring atmospheric pressure. Below this, a longer, narrower glass panel reveals a tube or column, also with increments and a coiled element at the bottom, possibly for mercury or another liquid used in measurement. The top of the object features a decorative curved crest with two thin metal hooks or wires protruding upward. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with minimal shadows or context. In the lower left corner, the text “WILLIAM SPIECKER” appears, presumably the artist’s signature.
title: Barometer
